clauses.reason: The clause adds the citizenship rule to the Civil Service Rules. EO 12107 changed the agency named from the Commission to OPM, effective 1979-01-01, and the held eCFR text of 5 CFR 7.3 (through 2026-10-29) reproduces paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) with OPM, citing the order as its source; no revocation or supersession was found.

research_rationale:
EO 11935 (41 FR 37301, signed 1976-09-02) amends Civil Service Rule VII (5 CFR Part 7) by adding a new section 7.4 (Citizenship): no person shall be admitted to competitive examination, or appointed in the competitive service, unless a citizen or national of the United States, with the Commission authorized to make exceptions to the extent permitted by law for aliens when necessary to promote the efficiency of the service in specific cases or for temporary appointments. The held Federal Register original has no sunset or condition. Later instruments held: EO 12107 (signed 1978-12-28), section 2-101(a), lists EO 11935 among the orders amended by substituting the Office of Personnel Management for the Civil Service Commission, effective 1979-01-01 under its section 2-404; and the 2020 EO 13940 recites EO 11935 in a compliance-review direction without amending or ending it (a recital, not an end). The held eCFR text of 5 CFR 7.3 (amended through 2026-10-29) reproduces the rule as three paragraphs with OPM in place of the Commission, and its source note reads 'E.O. 11935, 41 FR 37301, Sept. 3, 1976. Redesignated by E.O. 13197, 66 FR 7853, Jan. 25, 2001', a renumbering of the section (7.4 to 7.3) in the codified rule, not a revocation or supersession; the text of EO 13197 is not attached as a later event because it is not an actor text in the packet, and it does not end the rule since the held 5 CFR 7.3 text keeps all three paragraphs. the bounded machine searches current-law:usc, current-law:ecfr and later-events:ofr_catalog were read for coverage and show no revocation or supersession.
